description.value: Kitsilano Pool is one of the longest outdoor saltwater swimming pools in North America, stretching 137 metres along the waterfront in Vancouver's Kitsilano neighbourhood. Operated by the City of Vancouver, it sits steps from the Seaside Greenway cycling route, making it a natural rest stop for cyclists riding the waterfront. The pool also offers diving and is noted as wheelchair accessible.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website fetch was blocked by Cloudflare, so all evidence comes from OSM tags only. OSM confirms this is a real, publicly accessible outdoor saltwater swimming pool operated by the City of Vancouver at 2305 Cornwall Avenue, tagged as wheelchair accessible, 137 metres in length. No amenity-specific details (bike parking, washrooms, showers, etc.) can be confirmed from OSM tags alone, so those fields are set to null.
concerns: Website fetch blocked by Cloudflare (Ray ID: a0670512289fef12); all amenity fields unverifiable and set to null. Manual review of the Vancouver Parks page recommended to confirm bike parking, washrooms, showers, and other amenities.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A well-known, publicly accessible City of Vancouver facility on a major cycling route; real and open, no grounds for exclusion.

wow_evidence: 137m heated saltwater pool on the beach — one of North America's longest outdoor pools, verifiable superlative; above the outdoor-pool delight-2 bar, genuinely day-shaping swim stop.
blurb: 137-metre heated saltwater outdoor pool on Kitsilano Beach, among North America's longest.
